7b38ab9c83.rewrite:
bsf rdx,rdx
movdqu XMMWORD PTR [rdi],xmm4
movdqu XMMWORD PTR [rdi+0x10],xmm5
add rdi,0x20
7b38ab9c83.why: rsi is not live on exit, so its increment can be removed while preserving both stores and all required register values.

00e57a3d73.why: The load, pointer increment and both arithmetic outputs are live, and replacing the copy and addition with LEA would lose the required carry flag.

d3001b9aff.why: The store, load and both pointer increments are required, while the live loaded value and addition carry prevent folding the copy and addition into LEA.

db8892dfb1.why: The vector comparison and mask extraction produce the required rdx value, and the r10 increment remains necessary for the final CF and ZF comparison.

a236f97740.why: The loaded ymm3 must remain intact, preventing load folding into the comparison, and the store, mask extraction and scalar updates are all required.

6d4e27ed8b.why: Both the store of incoming ymm2 and its final loaded value are required, as are the comparison mask, index update and flag-producing length subtraction.

41c8f12065.why: The loaded vector, comparison vector, scalar mask, index and remaining length are all live, and the store must also be preserved.

8f6b32e24a.why: Both loaded vectors are live, the byte comparison and mask extraction produce rdx, and the scalar comparison supplies the required CF and ZF.

ba2f82e70b.why: The store, byte comparison, mask extraction and scalar flag comparison each perform a required operation.

58055c55e4.why: The byte store, original-pointer result, incremented destination and decremented length with matching ZF each require their existing operation.

0180b5ffbb.why: All three arithmetic updates and the bit-scan result are live, and the final comparison is needed to produce CF.

9815748107.why: The pointer update and both adjustments of the bit-scan result remain live, and the final comparison must supply CF.

4aa51751bc.why: The zero-extended load, word store, two distinct pointer results and length subtraction producing ZF all remain required.

ae01414ebd.why: The word copy and separate zero-byte store cannot be widened without accessing extra bytes, and both pointer results and the length subtraction remain live.

076edb94d0.why: The loaded rdx value, dword store, two distinct pointer results and length subtraction producing ZF all remain required.

909a95c119.why: The unknown index prevents merging the two copies, and the two live pointer results plus the length decrement and its ZF leave no removable instruction.

c9b0ca7079.why: The two independently addressed qword copies and both pointer results are required, while the length must be reduced by rdx plus one with matching ZF.

494ae52b0a.why: The unknown index prevents merging the vector copies, and the remaining instructions produce the two required pointers and adjusted length with matching ZF.

8b485510df.why: The independently addressed vector copies cannot be combined under AVX2, and both pointer results and the length adjustment with matching ZF remain required.

2eec1d8180.why: The zero-extended byte load, store and return pointer are live, and vzeroupper is required to reproduce the upper half of ymm0.
